newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: COKE INVESTING 1 BLN RAND IN SAFRICA -SOURCES.
newsitem.headline: COKE INVESTING 1 BLN RAND IN SAFRICA -SOURCES.

text.p: U.S. soft drink company Coca Cola Inc plans to invest around one billion rand in South Africa to boost its market position, industry sources said on Monday.
The company is scheduled to hold a news conference on its plans at 1030 GMT.
Business Report newspaper said company president Doug Ivester was expected to announce the investment by Coke and its South African bottlers, which would be spread over a number of years.
Coca Cola has seven bottlers in South Africa who operate 27 bottling plants.
